entry.title: The "tragedy of the cognitive commons" explains how rational AI adoption could destroy entire professions' expertise
entry.summary: A new research paper frames AI adoption as a "tragedy of the cognitive commons." Every company that cuts entry-level jobs benefits individually, but the collective expertise of entire professions erodes. entry.title: Why AI Benchmarks Mean Less Than You Think
entry.summary: Every model launch comes with a chart. Bars, usually, or a spider diagram, showing the new model edging past its rivals on a row of benchmarks with acronyms most people cannot expand. The bar is taller. The press writes it up as a leap.
